skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concepts of human resource management, responsibilities, roles of dedicated human resource departments, and factors influencing human resource activities.
Analyze job functions, recruitment, performance evaluation, training and development, compensation, and employee retention strategies.
Analyze strategic recruitment approaches, including job analysis, recruitment, and selection processes.
Evaluate and apply techniques for performance evaluation within organizations.
Develop and implement training and development strategies for employees.
Design compensation and benefits packages that motivate and retain employees.
Implement strategies to retain valuable employees within organizations.
Write clear and concise reports on human resource management topics.
Apply problem-solving skills to address issues related to human resource management.
